research_question: Among the frozen W4-C/R1 EARNINGS_EPS official-domain universe, do pre-specified ARGOS point-in-time prediction-market signals translate into positive market-adjusted net equity returns after costs, benchmark and multiplicity control?

universe.homogeneity_policy: Do not mix macro, FDA, litigation, M&A or other event families into the primary economic backtest. Non-earnings families require separate family-specific protocols.

eligibility_policy_pre_outcome.selection_principle: include every frozen full-expansion EARNINGS_EPS opportunity that can be joined deterministically to a PIT signal, an issuer/ticker identity, tradable equity prices and the benchmark under the pre-specified timing rules; exclude only deterministic data-quality failures documented before PnL aggregation
not_allowed: manual removal of bad trades after seeing returns
year or ticker window selection based on performance
promotion of a diagnostic challenger after primary failure
required_fields_before_execution: PIT probability/signal fields required by the selected rule
eligibility_policy_pre_outcome.n_final_backtestable_policy: N_final_backtestable must be materialized by deterministic joins and logged before PnL summaries are interpreted. It cannot be chosen manually or optimized after return inspection.

primary_signal_family.name: ARGOS_PIT_PROBABILITY_AND_MOVEMENT_LAYER
hierarchy: M2 aggregate prediction-market probability sensor / baseline information layer
M_MOVE_CORE movement/incremental layer only if pre-specified gate conditions are satisfied
primary_signal_family.interpretation: The strategy concept remains sensor-first: prediction markets are point-in-time information sensors, and capital is deployed only when frozen rules survive the economic gate.

primary_rule.name: R1_EXPANDED_PRIMARY
primary_rule.rule_family: fixed-threshold PIT signal to equity exposure
primary_rule.direction_policy: long/short/no-trade mapping must be defined mechanically by the executor from pre-outcome PIT signal fields; no threshold or direction can be changed after outcomes or returns are read
primary_rule.threshold_policy: reuse or explicitly freeze thresholds before execution; no grid search over thresholds in the primary claim
primary_rule.no_trade_policy: events failing the fixed signal conditions receive zero return per eligible opportunity

null_policy.name: C0_NO_TRADE
null_policy.definition: zero exposure for every eligible opportunity
null_policy.champion_default: C0_NO_TRADE remains champion unless the primary rule passes all frozen statistical and economic gates

secondary_rules.policy: No secondary rule may replace a failed primary rule in the final report. Secondary diagnostics require a separate pre-registered robustness appendix or future cycle.

timing_and_execution.entry: first exchange-session open strictly after the frozen PIT observation timestamp and after all information required by the signal is available
timing_and_execution.primary_exit: 10 trading sessions after entry unless a stricter event-relative exit is explicitly implementable from frozen dates
timing_and_execution.position_sizing: equal notional per eligible opportunity; zero for no-trade; no leverage; no ticker-level or year-level optimization
timing_and_execution.overlap_policy: event-level opportunity returns are primary. Financed portfolio Sharpe, equity curve and max drawdown are not authorized unless a separate overlapping-capital accounting convention is frozen before returns are summarized.

costs_and_benchmark.benchmark: SPY matched-session benchmark unless the executor freeze justifies a deterministic ticker/market benchmark before returns are read
costs_and_benchmark.slippage_policy: fixed screening cost assumption only; do not claim realized execution slippage precision

metrics.primary_metric: mean market-adjusted net return per eligible opportunity, with no-trade encoded as zero
secondary_metrics: mean market-adjusted net return per executed trade
one-sided p-value for positive mean opportunity return
Holm-adjusted p-value when multiple horizons or families are reported

multiplicity_and_stop_rules.correction: Holm correction across explicitly reported rule/horizon tests
promotion_gate: primary mean market-adjusted net return per eligible opportunity must be positive
confidence interval and/or p-value must support a positive economic effect under the frozen test
result must remain reportable if negative, null or inconclusive
C0_NO_TRADE remains champion if the primary rule fails
multiplicity_and_stop_rules.stop_rule: If R1_EXPANDED_PRIMARY fails, no diagnostic or sensitivity rule can be promoted as the final strategy in the same submission cycle.

report_policy.if_pass: Report the expanded economic result as a frozen gate-passing capital translation, with exact N_final_backtestable, costs, benchmark, uncertainty and limitations.
report_policy.if_fail_or_null: Report disciplined no-trade / capital preservation as the outcome. Do not hide or rescue the result.
report_policy.if_incomplete_before_submission: Report the full 1355 official-domain expansion as infrastructure progress and keep the older economic backtest as the last completed financial result with explicit small-N limitation.

next_required_artifacts: executor freeze proving the implementation follows this protocol and has no pre-freeze outcome/return/settlement reads
execution authorization for N_final_backtestable materialization and economic backtest only after executor freeze
result freeze after execution, including exact N_final_backtestable and all metrics
